text: Svelte is a compiler-based UI framework for writing concise components using familiar HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
quote: a UI framework that uses a compiler to let you write breathtakingly concise components that do minimal work in the browser, using languages you already know — HTML, CSS and JavaScript

text: The compiler converts declarative components into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM
quote: It's a compiler that takes your declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM.

text: A public roadmap is available showing what the core team is currently working on
quote: You may view our roadmap if you'd like to see what we're currently working on.

text: An official Discord chatroom exists for community help and discussion
Svelte Society, a sister organization, runs local chapters and events around the world
quote: Our sister organisation, Svelte Society, organises events around the globe. Find your chapter and join us in our Discord server.

text: A contributing guide and package structure documentation exist for contributing to the Svelte codebase
quote: Please see the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [`svelte`](packages/svelte) package for information on contributing to Svelte.
